title: Living Next Door to a Sibling

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager's sibling next door walks in without knocking and borrows everything: set a rule, or give up and enjoy it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) have just built huts right next to each other. It seemed a lovely idea. Now (friend) wanders into (subject)'s hut every morning without knocking, borrows things without asking and has opinions about where (subject) keeps (subject.his/her) cooking pots.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Knock," says (subject). "Please. And ask before you borrow." (friend) looks wounded. "But we're family." "That's why I'm asking nicely," says (subject). (friend) grumbles, but starts knocking. Mostly. Sometimes (friend.he/she) knocks while already halfway through the door. (subject) decides that counts. They're still siblings. Some things you just live with.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides to stop fighting it. (subject.He/she) starts walking into (friend)'s hut without knocking too, borrowing (friend.his/her) things and rearranging (friend.his/her) cooking pots. Within a week (friend) is asking (subject.him/her) to knock. "Oh?" says (subject). "Interesting." They agree on a rule together. It is the same rule (subject) wanted in the first place.
